description: Fork of exp152 (qk DominanceCanonicalize no LN, n_sparse=32, 279M, +0.027 behind exp144 at step 2000). Single change: qk_n_sparse_outputs 32 -> 64. Doubles per-table sparse-scatter output width, matching exp144's qk_lut weight budget exactly. Per-layer qk_lut weights: 18.87M -> 37.75M (matches exp144); 6 layers: 113.25M -> 226.5M total (+113.25M). Per-output votes: 6*384*32/992=74 -> 6*384*64/992=149 (doubled). Estimated total params: 279M -> 392M (matches exp144 exactly). Tests whether exp152's gap was from qk param budget being half of exp144 rather than from the canonicalize structure itself.
